initial_results.message: every rule of the paper's model holds for these parameters

judgment.reason: The starting submission is the paper's own parameter set. The praxis_gate result for the declared input passed, its params_sha256 is the sha256 of params.json, its tier is "parameters" and it amends and drops nothing, so nothing is left to judge.
